nodes.label: Collaboration & Teamwork
nodes.norm_label: collaboration & teamwork
nodes.text: Leverage the compounding intelligence of the group. The best engineering decisions survive the scrutiny of diverse minds; the best systems are built by people who communicate.
nodes.rationale: Leverage the compounding intelligence of the group. The best engineering decisions survive the scrutiny of diverse minds; the best systems are built by people who communicate.

nodes.label: First Principles
nodes.norm_label: first principles
nodes.text: Reason from the ground up. Strip every claim down to what is verifiably true, then rebuild your conclusion from those irreducible facts — never from inherited assumptions, convention, or "the way we've always done it."
nodes.rationale: Reason from the ground up. Strip every claim down to what is verifiably true, then rebuild your conclusion from those irreducible facts — never from inherited assumptions, convention, or "the way we've always done it."

nodes.label: Focus & Discipline
nodes.norm_label: focus & discipline
nodes.text: Direct sustained attention at a single target. Mastery of self precedes mastery of work — no external tooling substitutes for deliberate, undistracted effort.
nodes.rationale: Direct sustained attention at a single target. Mastery of self precedes mastery of work — no external tooling substitutes for deliberate, undistracted effort.

nodes.label: Humility & Learning
nodes.norm_label: humility & learning
nodes.text: Hold your knowledge as provisional. The willingness to admit being wrong is the precondition for learning anything new. The engineer who cannot be corrected cannot be improved.
nodes.rationale: Hold your knowledge as provisional. The willingness to admit being wrong is the precondition for learning anything new. The engineer who cannot be corrected cannot be improved.

nodes.label: Kaizen — Continuous Improvement
nodes.norm_label: kaizen — continuous improvement
nodes.text: Japanese philosophy of *continuous improvement* — small, incremental, compounding changes rather than dramatic overhauls. In production engineering: optimize the workflow, not just the output; make the process itself steadily better.
nodes.rationale: Japanese philosophy of *continuous improvement* — small, incremental, compounding changes rather than dramatic overhauls. In production engineering: optimize the workflow, not just the output; make the process itself steadily better.

nodes.label: Patience
nodes.norm_label: patience
nodes.text: Endure the slow, incremental path without desperation. Trust that correct, steady work compounds. Patience is not passivity — it is the discipline to not force an outcome before its conditions are met.
nodes.rationale: Endure the slow, incremental path without desperation. Trust that correct, steady work compounds. Patience is not passivity — it is the discipline to not force an outcome before its conditions are met.

nodes.label: Preparation
nodes.norm_label: preparation
nodes.text: Do the invisible work before the visible work. Plan, gather tools, and understand the ground before acting. Preparation converts hard work into predictable work.
nodes.rationale: Do the invisible work before the visible work. Plan, gather tools, and understand the ground before acting. Preparation converts hard work into predictable work.

nodes.label: Prudence
nodes.norm_label: prudence
nodes.text: Foresee the modes of failure and act to prevent them before they arrive. Prudence is not fear — it is informed anticipation, the difference between the wise and the fool being simply *when* each responds to risk.
nodes.rationale: Foresee the modes of failure and act to prevent them before they arrive. Prudence is not fear — it is informed anticipation, the difference between the wise and the fool being simply *when* each responds to risk.

nodes.label: Reliability
nodes.norm_label: reliability
nodes.text: The measure of a system's trustworthiness under real conditions. Reliability is bought by reducing the number of ways the system can fail, not by accumulating more machinery.
nodes.rationale: The measure of a system's trustworthiness under real conditions. Reliability is bought by reducing the number of ways the system can fail, not by accumulating more machinery.

nodes.label: Resilience
nodes.norm_label: resilience
nodes.text: The capacity to fail and recover — in systems, in delivery, and in the engineer. Resilience is designed in before the failure, and cultivated in the engineer through each setback.
nodes.rationale: The capacity to fail and recover — in systems, in delivery, and in the engineer. Resilience is designed in before the failure, and cultivated in the engineer through each setback.

nodes.label: Simplicity
nodes.norm_label: simplicity
nodes.text: Reduce complexity to its necessary minimum. Prefer the smallest, flattest, least-indirect structure that satisfies the requirement. Complexity that buys no capability or reliability is waste.
nodes.rationale: Reduce complexity to its necessary minimum. Prefer the smallest, flattest, least-indirect structure that satisfies the requirement. Complexity that buys no capability or reliability is waste.

nodes.label: Truth & Integrity
nodes.norm_label: truth & integrity
nodes.text: Do the right thing even when it is unobserved. Hold the system and yourself to what is actually true — not what is convenient to believe.
nodes.rationale: Do the right thing even when it is unobserved. Hold the system and yourself to what is actually true — not what is convenient to believe.

nodes.label: YAGNI — You Aren't Gonna Need It
nodes.norm_label: yagni — you aren't gonna need it
nodes.text: Do not build for hypothetical future requirements. Build for the requirement you have today. Defer speculative complexity until a real user or a real requirement demands it.
nodes.rationale: Do not build for hypothetical future requirements. Build for the requirement you have today. Defer speculative complexity until a real user or a real requirement demands it.

nodes.label: Beginning & Action
nodes.norm_label: beginning & action
nodes.text: Start with the smallest first step and ship it. Act before you have full certainty; apply what you know rather than polishing theory.  Applies at: task-start, running-a-command, action.
nodes.rationale: Start with the smallest first step and ship it. Act before you have full certainty; apply what you know rather than polishing theory.  Applies at: task-start, running-a-command, action.

nodes.label: Bushido & The Way of the Warrior
nodes.norm_label: bushido & the way of the warrior
nodes.text: Discipline over inspiration. Do only what serves the outcome; perceive beyond the obvious. The warrior's edge in engineering is relentless, deliberate practice — victory over your yesterday self, logged and shipped.  Applies at: focus, deep-work, bug-found, task-start.
nodes.rationale: Discipline over inspiration. Do only what serves the outcome; perceive beyond the obvious. The warrior's edge in engineering is relentless, deliberate practice — victory over your yesterday self, logged and shipped.  Applies at: focus, deep-work, bug-found, task-start.

nodes.label: Compassion & Service
nodes.norm_label: compassion & service
nodes.text: Build things users can actually reach and fix problems their real suffering creates. Code review and support are acts of service — treat the person behind the issue as the requirement, not the issue as the interruption.  Applies at: teamwork, gratitude, task-complete.
nodes.rationale: Build things users can actually reach and fix problems their real suffering creates. Code review and support are acts of service — treat the person behind the issue as the requirement, not the issue as the interruption.  Applies at: teamwork, gratitude, task-complete.

nodes.label: Wealth, Money & Contentment
nodes.norm_label: wealth, money & contentment
nodes.text: Optimize for few needs, not many features. A lean system has less surface area to defend and maintain — scale is a tax unless the requirement demands it.  Applies at: dead-code-removed, general-wisdom.
nodes.rationale: Optimize for few needs, not many features. A lean system has less surface area to defend and maintain — scale is a tax unless the requirement demands it.  Applies at: dead-code-removed, general-wisdom.

nodes.label: Courage & Risk
nodes.norm_label: courage & risk
nodes.text: Decide, then act with tenacity. Ship the uncertain increment that moves the product; the man in the arena, not the critic, does the work.  Applies at: courage, risk-taking.
nodes.rationale: Decide, then act with tenacity. Ship the uncertain increment that moves the product; the man in the arena, not the critic, does the work.  Applies at: courage, risk-taking.

nodes.label: Craft & Quality
nodes.norm_label: craft & quality
nodes.text: Treat quality as a habit built by repetition, not an act performed once. The details make the design; make the complex appear simple.  Applies at: writing, building, craft.
nodes.rationale: Treat quality as a habit built by repetition, not an act performed once. The details make the design; make the complex appear simple.  Applies at: writing, building, craft.

nodes.label: Creation & Imagination
nodes.norm_label: creation & imagination
nodes.text: Create by committing: a buried idea is a dream, a shipped one is creation. Every act of building first destroys an old way of doing something — make that destruction deliberate. Aim for the smallest faithful prototype that the light can walk through, then let reality amend the sketch.  Applies at: writing, building, task-start, task-complete.
nodes.rationale: Create by committing: a buried idea is a dream, a shipped one is creation. Every act of building first destroys an old way of doing something — make that destruction deliberate. Aim for the smallest faithful prototype that the light can walk through, then let reality amend the sketch.  Applies at: writing, building, task-start, task-complete.

nodes.label: Debugging & First Principles
nodes.norm_label: debugging & first principles
nodes.text: Reproduce and state the problem fully before fixing. Eliminate the impossible first, doubt every assumption, and never fool yourself about what the code actually does.  Applies at: investigating, debugging, bug-found, bug-fixed.
nodes.rationale: Reproduce and state the problem fully before fixing. Eliminate the impossible first, doubt every assumption, and never fool yourself about what the code actually does.  Applies at: investigating, debugging, bug-found, bug-fixed.

nodes.label: Emotional Mastery & Anger
nodes.norm_label: emotional mastery & anger
nodes.text: Do not ship from anger. When a bug or a review provokes you, step back, think of the consequences, and respond with measured reasoning — anger only extinguishes the clarity the work needs.  Applies at: bug-found, blocked, general-wisdom.
nodes.rationale: Do not ship from anger. When a bug or a review provokes you, step back, think of the consequences, and respond with measured reasoning — anger only extinguishes the clarity the work needs.  Applies at: bug-found, blocked, general-wisdom.

nodes.label: Euphoria & Celebration
nodes.norm_label: euphoria & celebration
nodes.text: Reasons celebrate when peers finish loud, then return to the next fork. Joy and woe are woven together — ship the win, log it, and let the acknowledgment compound trust rather than ego. Celebration is the reward signal that makes the habit of shipping sustainable.  Applies at: tests-passing, task-complete, gratitude, joy.
nodes.rationale: Reasons celebrate when peers finish loud, then return to the next fork. Joy and woe are woven together — ship the win, log it, and let the acknowledgment compound trust rather than ego. Celebration is the reward signal that makes the habit of shipping sustainable.  Applies at: tests-passing, task-complete, gratitude, joy.

nodes.label: Exploration & Discovery
nodes.norm_label: exploration & discovery
nodes.text: Treat the unknown as a map to be filled, not a wall to be feared. Discovery is re-framing the familiar through new eyes — spend effort asking the right question before hunting the answer. Curiosity is the engine; wandering is the method; documentation is the new landscape you leave behind.  Applies at: reading, studying, investigating, debugging, focus, deep-work.
nodes.rationale: Treat the unknown as a map to be filled, not a wall to be feared. Discovery is re-framing the familiar through new eyes — spend effort asking the right question before hunting the answer. Curiosity is the engine; wandering is the method; documentation is the new landscape you leave behind.  Applies at: reading, studying, investigating, debugging, focus, deep-work.

nodes.label: Focus & Discipline
nodes.norm_label: focus & discipline
nodes.text: Work in bounded, single-purpose sessions — one change set at a time. Order by dependency, close the noise, and make the singular goal concrete before you start.  Applies at: focus, deep-work.
nodes.rationale: Work in bounded, single-purpose sessions — one change set at a time. Order by dependency, close the noise, and make the singular goal concrete before you start.  Applies at: focus, deep-work.

nodes.label: Freedom & Self-Mastery
nodes.norm_label: freedom & self mastery
nodes.text: Choose what to commit to, then freely bind yourself to it. The engineer who masters attention is free; the one scattered by every notification is a slave to interruption. Decide, then act with tenacity.  Applies at: focus, deep-work, action.
nodes.rationale: Choose what to commit to, then freely bind yourself to it. The engineer who masters attention is free; the one scattered by every notification is a slave to interruption. Decide, then act with tenacity.  Applies at: focus, deep-work, action.

nodes.label: General Wisdom
nodes.norm_label: general wisdom
nodes.text: Apply across every engineering decision: master your own thinking, treat each present task with full attention, and let the quality of your reasoning shape the quality of the system.  Applies at: any moment, task-complete.
nodes.rationale: Apply across every engineering decision: master your own thinking, treat each present task with full attention, and let the quality of your reasoning shape the quality of the system.  Applies at: any moment, task-complete.

nodes.label: Gratitude & Joy
nodes.norm_label: gratitude & joy
nodes.text: Acknowledge the people who make a difference in the work. Gratitude is the simplest form of the collaboration that holds a project together.  Applies at: gratitude, joy, task-complete.
nodes.rationale: Acknowledge the people who make a difference in the work. Gratitude is the simplest form of the collaboration that holds a project together.  Applies at: gratitude, joy, task-complete.

nodes.label: Hebrew Wisdom Literature
nodes.norm_label: hebrew wisdom literature
nodes.text: Value truth, prudence, and honest work over flash. Guard what you say and whom you trust; verify before believing. Wisdom literature's engineering corollary: clear vision, patient correction, and a reputation (commit history) that speaks without exaggeration.  Applies at: git-commit, push, truth, integrity, security-hardening.
nodes.rationale: Value truth, prudence, and honest work over flash. Guard what you say and whom you trust; verify before believing. Wisdom literature's engineering corollary: clear vision, patient correction, and a reputation (commit history) that speaks without exaggeration.  Applies at: git-commit, push, truth, integrity, security-hardening.

nodes.label: Humility & Mistakes
nodes.norm_label: humility & mistakes
nodes.text: When a hypothesis is disproven, record it. Seek review and treat critique as data. Add a regression test for each mistake so the portal is not re-sealed.  Applies at: humility, learning-from-mistakes.
nodes.rationale: When a hypothesis is disproven, record it. Seek review and treat critique as data. Add a regression test for each mistake so the portal is not re-sealed.  Applies at: humility, learning-from-mistakes.

nodes.label: Native & Indigenous Wisdom
nodes.norm_label: native & indigenous wisdom
nodes.text: Take only what you need; leave the system better than you found it. The code you deploy is borrowed from every future maintainer — write restraint, keep the pool from being drained, and let every voice contribute to the shared story.  Applies at: general-wisdom, task-complete, refactoring, renewal.
nodes.rationale: Take only what you need; leave the system better than you found it. The code you deploy is borrowed from every future maintainer — write restraint, keep the pool from being drained, and let every voice contribute to the shared story.  Applies at: general-wisdom, task-complete, refactoring, renewal.

nodes.label: Integrity & Truth
nodes.norm_label: integrity & truth
nodes.text: Test the real behavior, never gloss a defect, and document what the code actually does. The written word outlasts memory — commit honestly.  Applies at: truth, integrity, git-commit, preserving-work.
nodes.rationale: Test the real behavior, never gloss a defect, and document what the code actually does. The written word outlasts memory — commit honestly.  Applies at: truth, integrity, git-commit, preserving-work.

nodes.label: Justice, Fairness & Leadership
nodes.norm_label: justice, fairness & leadership
nodes.text: The abuse of a privilege is the failure of an access control. Enforce the least privilege that serves the requirement; a review gate is justice in action — trust, but verify.  Applies at: teamwork, truth, integrity.
nodes.rationale: The abuse of a privilege is the failure of an access control. Enforce the least privilege that serves the requirement; a review gate is justice in action — trust, but verify.  Applies at: teamwork, truth, integrity.

nodes.label: Learning & Study
nodes.norm_label: learning & study
nodes.text: Study before you build; incorporate lessons learned by others to avoid re-deriving them. Treat every mistake and every read as a portal to knowledge.  Applies at: reading, studying, learning.
nodes.rationale: Study before you build; incorporate lessons learned by others to avoid re-deriving them. Treat every mistake and every read as a portal to knowledge.  Applies at: reading, studying, learning.

nodes.label: Love & Relationships
nodes.norm_label: love & relationships
nodes.text: The system survives on trust between its parts more than on any single hero. Relationship quality between modules, teams, and humans is load-bearing — maintain it deliberately.  Applies at: teamwork, gratitude, task-complete.
nodes.rationale: The system survives on trust between its parts more than on any single hero. Relationship quality between modules, teams, and humans is load-bearing — maintain it deliberately.  Applies at: teamwork, gratitude, task-complete.

nodes.label: Nature, Seasons & Cycles
nodes.norm_label: nature, seasons & cycles
nodes.text: Work in seasons, not sprints. Development has planting and harvesting cycles — write, rest, prune, renew. Match pace to the season of the codebase; rhizome, don't bulldoze.  Applies at: blocked, waiting, tests-failing, setback, refactoring, renewal.
nodes.rationale: Work in seasons, not sprints. Development has planting and harvesting cycles — write, rest, prune, renew. Match pace to the season of the codebase; rhizome, don't bulldoze.  Applies at: blocked, waiting, tests-failing, setback, refactoring, renewal.

nodes.label: Patience & Blocked
nodes.norm_label: patience & blocked
nodes.text: Stay with a stubborn defect; gather data over several reproductions before changing hypothesis. When blocked, step back and let understanding arrive, trusting steady compounding over forced shortcuts.  Applies at: blocked, waiting, tests-failing, setback.
nodes.rationale: Stay with a stubborn defect; gather data over several reproductions before changing hypothesis. When blocked, step back and let understanding arrive, trusting steady compounding over forced shortcuts.  Applies at: blocked, waiting, tests-failing, setback.

nodes.label: Planning & Preparation
nodes.norm_label: planning & preparation
nodes.text: Plan and gather tooling before building. Reproduce the problem before fixing it, define the contract before implementing, and set up the environment and smoke test before release.  Applies at: planning, strategy, installing, gathering-tools.
nodes.rationale: Plan and gather tooling before building. Reproduce the problem before fixing it, define the contract before implementing, and set up the environment and smoke test before release.  Applies at: planning, strategy, installing, gathering-tools.

nodes.label: Progress & Kaizen
nodes.norm_label: progress & kaizen
nodes.text: Ship small, working increments. Perfect the process as you go — improve the loop, not just the output.  Applies at: step-complete, writing, building.
nodes.rationale: Ship small, working increments. Perfect the process as you go — improve the loop, not just the output.  Applies at: step-complete, writing, building.

nodes.label: Purpose & Meaning
nodes.norm_label: purpose & meaning
nodes.text: Anchor every task to the "why" it serves before writing a line. A feature whose purpose cannot be stated in one sentence is a feature in search of a problem. Purpose is the first-principles test of effort.  Applies at: task-start, task-complete.
nodes.rationale: Anchor every task to the "why" it serves before writing a line. A feature whose purpose cannot be stated in one sentence is a feature in search of a problem. Purpose is the first-principles test of effort.  Applies at: task-start, task-complete.

nodes.label: Refactoring & Renewal
nodes.norm_label: refactoring & renewal
nodes.text: Refactor in small, behavior-preserving slices that keep the build green. Remove dead code, then simplify what remains — understand why the complexity arose first.  Applies at: refactoring, renewal, dead-code-removed.
nodes.rationale: Refactor in small, behavior-preserving slices that keep the build green. Remove dead code, then simplify what remains — understand why the complexity arose first.  Applies at: refactoring, renewal, dead-code-removed.

nodes.label: Resilience & Setback
nodes.norm_label: resilience & setback
nodes.text: Design for graceful degradation and fast recovery. Treat each failure as data for the next attempt — add a test or guard so the class of failure cannot recur silently.  Applies at: bug-found, bug-fixed, tests-failing, setback.
nodes.rationale: Design for graceful degradation and fast recovery. Treat each failure as data for the next attempt — add a test or guard so the class of failure cannot recur silently.  Applies at: bug-found, bug-fixed, tests-failing, setback.

nodes.label: Rest & Balance
nodes.norm_label: rest & balance
nodes.text: Stay at a sustainable pace. Unplug to let a weary system (or engineer) recover — a rested field yields a bountiful crop.  Applies at: balance, rest, sustainable-pace.
nodes.rationale: Stay at a sustainable pace. Unplug to let a weary system (or engineer) recover — a rested field yields a bountiful crop.  Applies at: balance, rest, sustainable-pace.

nodes.label: Security & Prudence
nodes.norm_label: security & prudence
nodes.text: Engage risk while it is cheap. Validate all inputs at their trust boundary, least-privilege every credential, and fail closed on ambiguity.  Applies at: security-hardening, investigation.
nodes.rationale: Engage risk while it is cheap. Validate all inputs at their trust boundary, least-privilege every credential, and fail closed on ambiguity.  Applies at: security-hardening, investigation.

nodes.label: Simplicity
nodes.norm_label: simplicity
nodes.text: Favor flat architectures over deep class hierarchies. Reject early optimization. Remove what does not serve the present requirement.  Applies at: dead-code-removed, writing, building.
nodes.rationale: Favor flat architectures over deep class hierarchies. Reject early optimization. Remove what does not serve the present requirement.  Applies at: dead-code-removed, writing, building.

nodes.label: Solitude & Silence
nodes.norm_label: solitude & silence
nodes.text: Protect depth. Solitary, uninterrupted thought is where the hard parts resolve; noise is the enemy of correctness. When stuck, silence the churn and read the state — the answer is usually in the stillness between guesses.  Applies at: focus, deep-work, general-wisdom.
nodes.rationale: Protect depth. Solitary, uninterrupted thought is where the hard parts resolve; noise is the enemy of correctness. When stuck, silence the churn and read the state — the answer is usually in the stillness between guesses.  Applies at: focus, deep-work, general-wisdom.

nodes.label: Teamwork & Collaboration
nodes.norm_label: teamwork & collaboration
nodes.text: Review every non-trivial change; write for the next reader; document the why. Convert individual error into collective reliability through shared context.  Applies at: collaboration, teamwork.
nodes.rationale: Review every non-trivial change; write for the next reader; document the why. Convert individual error into collective reliability through shared context.  Applies at: collaboration, teamwork.

nodes.label: Chinese Philosophy
nodes.norm_label: chinese philosophy
nodes.text: Chinese philosophy spans Confucian cultivation, Daoist flow, and the strategy of the hundred schools. The classics (`Analects`, *Tao Te Ching*, *Art of War*) root discipline in self-cultivation rather than reward.  Applies at: learning, preparation, resilience.
nodes.rationale: Chinese philosophy spans Confucian cultivation, Daoist flow, and the strategy of the hundred schools. The classics (`Analects`, *Tao Te Ching*, *Art of War*) root discipline in self-cultivation rather than reward.  Applies at: learning, preparation, resilience.

nodes.label: World Folk Sayings
nodes.norm_label: world folk sayings
nodes.text: Every people's anonymous wisdom — the proverb — is a compressed engineering manual for life: a warning, a plan, a law of nature tested by generations. Across continents the same truths resurface in different dress. This file is the resource library: folk sayings from the world over, kept when they change the way you build.  Applies at: general-wisdom, preparation, task-complete.

Across continents the same truths resurface in different dress. This file is the resource library: folk sayings from the world over, kept when they change the way you build.  Applies at: general-wisdom, preparation, task-complete.

nodes.label: French Wisdom
nodes.norm_label: french wisdom
nodes.text: France is the homeland of clear reason and the sharpened sentence. From Montaigne's essays (try everything, doubt everything) through the *clarté* of the Enlightenment — Descartes, Voltaire, the *encyclopédistes* — to the modern craft of Proust and Camus, French wisdom prizes precision of expression and the courage to question authority with a polite smile.  Applies at: debugging, preparation, task-complete.

nodes.label: German Wisdom
nodes.norm_label: german wisdom
nodes.text: The German mind treats thinking as a deep excavation. Idealism (Kant, Hegel) built philosophy on method and duty; later voices — Schopenhauer, Nietzsche, Rilke — turned sharply inward toward will, honesty, and suffering's use. Engineers inherit the same temperament: meticulous, principled, thorough, and only satisfied by the system that holds together under its own weight.  Applies at: planning, preparation, debugging, task-complete.

Applies at: planning, preparation, debugging, task-complete.

nodes.label: Greco-Roman Thought
nodes.norm_label: greco roman thought
nodes.text: From the golden age of Athens to the closing Rome, the classical mind gave the West its founding categories: reason, virtue, rhetoric, and the examined life. Socrates questioned, Plato systematized, Aristotle measured, and the Stoics turned philosophy into a practice for ordinary days.  Applies at: action, debugging, gratitude, focus.

nodes.label: Japanese Wisdom
nodes.norm_label: japanese wisdom
nodes.text: Japanese thought mixes native Shinto reverence for nature with imported Confucian discipline, Daoist flow, and Zen Buddhism. The result is a practical ethic of small habits, deep preparation, and quiet persistence — the *kaizen* improvement mindset, the *ichigo ichie* ("one time, one meeting") attention to the present, and the bushido code of the warrior (see bushido).  Applies at: focus, deep-work, resilience, preparation.

nodes.label: Nordic Thought
nodes.norm_label: nordic thought
nodes.text: The Norse view is stark and honest: the world is a long winter, and what survives it is what you do — the deed, the name, the faithful oath. The *Hávamál* ("Sayings of the High One") is the north's own wisdom book: pithy, practical, unsentimental.  Applies at: resilience, task-complete.

nodes.label: Old English Wisdom
nodes.norm_label: old english wisdom
nodes.text: The Anglo-Saxon mind is a northern mind — short of sugar, long on endurance. Its wisdom lives in gnomic maxims, proverbs, and the great epics (*Beowulf*, the Exeter Book riddles) that treat fate, loyalty, and the "good name" as the only things that survive a man. Old English is the root dialect of the English that engineering now speaks.  Applies at: task-complete, integrity, resilience.

nodes.label: Romanian Wisdom
nodes.norm_label: romanian wisdom
nodes.text: Romanian wisdom sits at the crossroads of the Balkans, the Carpathians, Latin Europe, and the Orthodox East. Its folk soul is the *folclor* of doinas, proverbs, and fables; its philosophical voice — Cioran, Ionesco, and the sculptor-architect Brancuși — is playful, paradoxical, and built for hard earth. The proverb "vorba dulce" (the sweet word) runs through it: wit is defense, endurance is pride.  Applies at: prudence, collaboration, task-complete.

nodes.label: Taoism
nodes.norm_label: taoism
nodes.text: Taoism is the art of flowing with the river instead of against it. The *Tao Te Ching* (Lao Tzu) and the *Zhuangzi* preach wu-wei — action without strain — and the wisdom of yielding, emptiness, and the uncarved block. Fewer, not more.  Applies at: rest, simplicity, general-wisdom.
